notes.title: 50% reached on Kickstarter !
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42050965/725137cd1a40014c2cdc615f867c7bdb07c0351a.png[/img]

50% of Revenge Story is funded on Kickstarter !

A huge thank you to the bakers!

We take this opportunity to make a small wink to the curious that you are: go discover the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/deusmarmota/revenge-story-a-visual-novel-with-a-very-open-narrative]Kickstarter[/url] page of the game and if you like the project, support it so that it can see the day!

We are working on Revenge Story with and for you. You now have the power to make it happen!

See you soon for more adventures!

notes.title: Kickstarter launched
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/deusmarmota/revenge-story-a-visual-novel-with-a-very-open-narrative][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42050965/db9ae089c24d636a7612f432ab026997e1819bf9.png[/img][/url]

Today we announce the launch of the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/deusmarmota/revenge-story-a-visual-novel-with-a-very-open-narrative]Kickstarter[/url] campaign to support the production of Revenge Story.

We're very excited and we hope you are too !

Support us to get special goodies, artbooks or the soundtrack of the game. Your support will make it possible to finance the continuation of the production of the game :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42050965/57290655ce045d456408354f489c9696cf81a6d1.png[/img]
During the campaign, you can find us at various fairs:

[list]
[*] Anime Focal Luxembourg on June 25 and 26, 2022 in Luxembourg
[*] Japan Tours Festival on July 1, 2 and 3, 2022 in Tours (France)
[*] Anime Focal Gravelines on July 30 and 31, 2022 in Gravelines (France)
[*] Man.Ga.Mes on August 13 and 14, 2022 in Chapelle-lez-Herlaimont (Belgium)
[/list]

And don't forget the social challenge!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42050965/b970e0780f4b81277a627ab5f6dee3b034cf6dfa.png[/img]
